notes: Concrete, returns Boolean. Treats the object as a screen-space 'capsule'/stadium shape defined by an endpoint (anInt6405=x1, anInt6402=y1), a second endpoint (anInt6406=x2, anInt6404=y2), and a radius (anInt6403); aBoolean6401 is an 'active' flag that short-circuits to false when unset. Computes the squared segment length i_3_, projects the query point (x,y) onto the segment via the dot product i_4_, and: if the projection falls before the segment start, tests distance from (x,y) to the start endpoint against radius^2; if past the end, tests distance to the end endpoint; otherwise (i_4_ shl 10)/i_3_ derives a 10-bit fixed-point interpolation factor used to find the nearest point on the segment and tests distance to that point -- i.e. a standard point-to-segment (capsule) containment/distance test. Field evidence: Direct3dModel.kt/OpenGlModel.kt/SoftwareModel.kt populate anInt6402/6403/6404/6405/6406 and set aBoolean6401=true from screen-projected model bounding-box corners during rendering (matching AbstractModel.csv's method608/renderOccluded and method615/renderOccludedSimple, which take a SceneOcculder param) -- so a SceneOcculder is a per-model screen-space occlusion capsule built each frame, and this method tests whether a given screen pixel/point falls within that capsule (used for occlusion culling of overlapping scenery, e.g. hiding a model behind another). SceneObjectSpawner.kt reads aBoolean6401 directly to skip inactive occluders; WidgetTextConfig.kt derives a bounding rectangle from (x1-r, x2+r, y1-r, y2+r) gated by the same flag; FireParticleStream.kt swaps the two endpoints in place (a orientation-normalization helper). Class extends SceneLinkedListNode, so instances are also linked-list nodes (see aClass318_Sub3Array6414 arrays of them in SceneEntityModel.kt), consistent with a per-frame pool of occluder shapes.
